question.text: Designate whether each of the following compounds is aromatic or not aromatic.

options.text: \(e, g\) aromatic and \(a, b, c, d, f, h\) not aromatic
\(b, e, f, g\) aromatic and \(a, c, d, h\) not aromatic
\(a, b, c, d\) aromatic and \(e, f, g, h\) not aromatic
\(a, c, d, e, h\) aromatic and \(b, f, g\) not aromatic

solution.text:
Aromatic compounds

a, c, d, e, h follow Huckel's rule
\(b, f, g\), are not aromatic, these compounds do not follow Huckel's rule
